subject: Jumpstart MAP & Reservation Tiers — eval schedule + burst policy
messages:
From: Simon Ellis <simon@aurelius.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@aurelius.health>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Jumpstart MAP idea + evaluation window

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The leadership team liked the low-latency routing and the cost breakdown you showed. We want to move from discovery to a short mutual action plan that ties milestones to committed capacity so we can get procurement and security aligned.

High-level asks from our side:
- A 6-8 week evaluation (pilot) for a 5-node GPU pool matching our inference profile (seq len ~1024, mixed batch sizes).
- A clearly tiered reservation pricing with an option to scale to 12 nodes if early metrics look good.
- Burst policy that allows temporary +30% capacity for traffic spikes with a defined per-minute pricing.
- A sample MAP doc and estimated ramp timeline we can show procurement.

Can you share a draft MAP that includes milestone-linked pricing (e.g., eval -> 3-month reserve -> 12-month commit) and a short timeline to close? Procurement will need a DocuSign-ready quote they can review next week.

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Ellis
Director of Engineering
Aurelius Health

Attachment: Aurelius_requirements_summary.txt (text)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Simon Ellis <simon@aurelius.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Jumpstart MAP idea + evaluation window

Simon — great to hear. I looped in Marissa (pricing/ops) and Rafael (solutions) so we can put a concrete MAP and a DocuSign-ready quote together. Quick answers up front:

- Pilot: 6 weeks, 5-GPU nodes (NVIDIA H100-like), target 80% p95 latency under your test set.
- Ramp: option to expand to 8 nodes at the conclusion of pilot; 12 nodes proposed for the 12-month commit.
- Burst: +30% capacity allowed for up to 60 minutes per day without prior notice at a fixed per-minute rate; overages billed weekly. We can also add an emergency ad-hoc burst at a higher rate.
- Pricing model: blended reservation tiers (pilot discounted, 3-month short commit, 12-month standard commit) + per-token/embedding unit.

Marissa — can you draft the MAP milestones (evaluation acceptance criteria, metric gates, billing milestones) and attach the tiered pricing sheet? Rafael — can you include a short ops note on instance sizing and KV cache assumptions for the eval?

Goal: get a MAP and quote to Aurelius by Monday EOD so procurement can start review.

-Jordan

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: jordan_blake@redwood.com | M: +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Simon Ellis <simon@aurelius.health>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Jumpstart MAP idea + evaluation window — draft MAP & pricing

Hi Simon/Jordan — attached is a first pass at the MAP and the GPU pool tier pricing workbook. Key items called out below:

MAP milestones (proposed):
1) Week 0: Contract & SOW signed (DocuSign). Pilot provisioning window: 3-5 business days.
2) Week 1–2: Test harness ingest + baseline perf runs (Redwood provides sample eval harness).
3) Week 3–4: Latency and throughput validation against acceptance criteria (p95 target and cost/unit targets).
4) Week 5–6: Finalize production sizing decision; execute reservation for short-commit (3-month) or 12-month term.

Pricing highlights (see attached workbook):
- Pilot (6-week): 30% discount off standard on-demand reservation rate; no early termination fee for pilot-only reserve.
- 3-month short commit: middling discount (15%) with option to convert remaining term to 12-month at time of upgrade; prorated billing.
- 12-month commit: best-in-class discount (28%) with predictable hourly rate and committed burst pool at a reduced minute rate.
- Burst: Default +30% available; first 60 minutes/day at negotiated burst-per-minute of $0.45/min/node (capped at 1,800 minutes/month across pool). After cap, ad-hoc burst at $0.75/min/node.

Other notes:
- We recommend conservative KV cache settings for the pilot to surface latency issues earlier; Rafael has provided ops notes inline.
- Attached workbook includes a sample cost curve for 5/8/12 node pools and the break-even points.

Next steps:
- Simon: confirm which commit path you prefer (3-month vs 12-month) so we can lock DocuSign terms.
- Jordan: I'll prep a DocuSign-ready quote once Simon confirms. Rafael, please paste ops sizing notes below.

Attachments: Aurelius_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, GPU_Pool_Tier_Pricing_Q4_2026.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Simon Ellis <simon@aurelius.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Jumpstart MAP idea + evaluation window — ops notes & confirmation

Simon — quick ops note to accompany the MAP:
- For pilot: 5 H100-class nodes, each with 80GB VRAM, reserved KV cache warm-up of 20% of typical session length to avoid cold-starts. Expect ~10–15% lower latency after the first 48 hours once caching stabilizes.
- Logging & audit: we'll enable token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency traces for the pilot (included in the pilot price).
- Scaling behavior: the burst pool uses pre-provisioned spare capacity in our region; if the +30% is exhausted we fall back to on-demand with slightly higher per-minute pricing.

Simon — per Marissa's note, once you confirm 3-month vs 12-month we will issue DocuSign. If you want, we can include a 30-day conversion window in the 3-month plan to move to 12-month with credit for months already paid.

Also attaching the signed MAP stub (for internal routing) — please route procurement to the DocuSign link below when you're ready.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/receipt/ABC123XYZ
